notes: «رويته عن أبي» and «محمد بن الحسن ... عن سعد بن عبد الله» are two routes that meet at Sa'd; «والحميري جميعا عن أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى» is read as the three routes meeting at Ahmad, the tail written once after them.
The reading that «جميعا» makes Sa'd and al-Himyari narrate together from Ahmad is the text's own marker; the tail is read that way.
«عن عائذ» at the end is the chain's last name; «عائذ بن حبيب الأحمسي» in the text.
